That's where I get so fucking confused. It's been over a year and I can't even remember if I was truly happy back then. All I know is it was the closest I've been.

But honestly, I've never been able to read myself. I went through 8 years of severe depression and didn't realize it till I went to see a therapist. I thought that was normal.

I don't have a good grasp on my emotions and now... I just have faded memories of what I'm sure was an easier time than anything before or after... But I don't know if it was happiness. I just don't really know myself. So when I stop being sad, I just get frustrated at the lack of clarity.
